# Minimum Sample Size for Escaped Defect Trust Score

Escaped defect trust scores are only computed and exposed if at least three fixes in a component have been observed (sample >= 3); otherwise, the metric is withheld.

To avoid exposing statistically unreliable defect metrics, controlling noise in quality signals as discussed in ADR-020 and related empirical stability requirements.)
